scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:admin"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && python -m uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.api:dev: cd apps/api && python -m uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.api:test: cd apps/api && python -m uv run pytest tests/ -v
scripts.setup: pnpm install --ignore-scripts && cd apps/api && python -m uv sync
